textNotes.text: Finally got back to giving this another attempt (Also peep the new wand from that failed run before!) There are obviously a GOOD amount of improvements that could be made. Considering the attempt went through with no deaths I will take it for now. Definitely some room for improvement. Just glad to get a run down on the books that didn't catastrophically fail. I realized that Kuldra's fight was going to be a major pain in the butt if I didnt go rest midway and sadly didn't bring any tea with me to restore rest on the fly.
